name: @foreman-line/verification
description: Stage-D verification harness for the Foreman Line (W3-P1). Executes a built parcel's acceptance criteria as pass/fail checks under the named-test convention (AC-CONVENTION.md), runs the verifier-side skill-injection matrix checks, and emits RFC-8785 Stage-D claim sub-receipts chained from the Stage-C dispatch receipt through a BuildResult bridge sub-receipt. Produces evidence only; the pass/rework verdict is W3-P3.
